object.attr: derived: CF-V48, open question Q8, the failure analysis's change to SRS-241. Two fresh templates can be equal and still be two requirements, and git takes the file once. Answered on 2026-11-11 (Q-V14), to confirm.
object.description: When both sides of a merge created an object under one object ID with equal files, Mellon shall count the two as different objects, unless the creating commits carry the same change.
